recent.text: Ball game. Sioux Falls wins it 155-131. Braden Smith finishes with 12 points and 14 assists. Rienk Mast 31 points, Cameron Hildreth 30.
recent.author: Dustin Dopirak

recent.text: Noblesville Boom fall to Sioux Falls Skyforce 155-131. Never led, and trailed by as many as 31. In his G League debut, Braden Smith with 12pts, 14asts in 35mins. Mast had 31. Hildreth (30) with his third 30-point game of the season. They gave up 92 paint points. https://t.co/p1i7IIJK26

recent.text: Braden Smith with six points on 2 of 2 shooting, 1 of-1 at the line (So it's worth two points). Nine assists, four rebounds, no turnovers at the break. Hildreth 19 points on 7 of 11 shooting, 3 of 6 from 3., Mast 17 on 7 of 10, 3 of 4.
recent.author: Dustin Dopirak

recent.text: Smith finds Brown on the pick-and-roll for the dunk. So Smith up to eight assists and there's still 2 minutes left in the first half.
recent.author: Dustin Dopirak

recent.text: Smith with his second field goal attempt and his second make. Another one where he gets into the lane, leans back and hits the fadeaway. That puts him at six points, seven assists, I believe.
recent.author: Dustin Dopirak

recent.text: Rienk Mast is off to a brillant start: 17 pts, 7-of-10 shooting, including 3/4 from deep. But Boom are trailing Skyforce 71-53. Hildreth has 16pts. Braden Smith (7asts) doing a great job of distributing the ball.
recent.author: Scott Agness

recent.text: Braden Smith with his sixth assist, swing past to Rienk Mast for yet another 3. Mast has 17 points on 7 of 10 shooting, 3 of 4 from 3.
